items.title: 68251_Teddy McRae oral history interview
items.q: Jeff who was a good friend of mine.

ctx.x: You ever find yourself in a situation where you ran out of reeds, or the reeds were no good and you had to either borrow some yourself or...?

Yeah. In Texas the weather was so hot and Oklahoma. It was like all0 at night -- in the daytime. Like when we get to the ballroom, it'll be like 100, you know, 90 and we play in shirt sleeves. It be (inaudible), you know. And Jeff and I, we used to put a glass of water down on the side. And when we get through playing a set, we wasn't going to (inaudible) play for a little while, we take off the mouthpiece and sit it in the water. Let it sit there. The horn would get so hot, the reed would just curl up and crack.…
